builds.name: Reference: Mana burst
builds.goal: Reference for Gragas: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee control mage who alternates defensive drinking and empowered attacks with dashes and precise displacement. Measure empowered W attacks after drinking, E access and R displacement. A bruiser route must compare survival and repeat casts rather than assume the burst combo always lands. AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
builds.summary: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Gragas: Measure empowered W attacks after drinking, E access and R displacement. A bruiser route must compare survival and repeat casts rather than assume the burst combo always lands.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mana is wasted on resource-free champions; target health and proc readiness change burst.

Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.

Gragas rolls a cask that explodes after [4] seconds, dealing between [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and [(80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.8) × AP) × (1.5)] magic damage and Slowing for between [40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60] and [(40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60) × 1.5]% for [2] seconds. The damage and Slow increase with time the cask spent before exploding. 

Gragas can Recast to detonate the cask early.

Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, Knocking Up nearby enemies for [1] second and dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage to them.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by [40]% if Gragas collides with an enemy.
Gragas hurls his cask, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and Knocking Away enemies from the impact zone.
When Gragas uses an Ability, Gragas takes a drink, restoring [(0.055) × Stat(12)] Health.

builds.name: Drunken spellblade tank
builds.summary: Trade one-shot burst for repeated protected empowered attacks.
builds.goal: Trade one-shot burst for repeated protected empowered attacks.
builds.hypothesis: Drunken Rage reduces damage with an AP term and empowers one attack with 0.7 AP plus 7% enemy max-health magic damage. Dusk and Dawn adds a separate attack proc, Riftmaker rewards continued combat, and Visage supports Happy Hour's 5.5% max-health heal. Body Slam's collision reduces its cooldown by 40%, helping create another W window.
testPlan: Required state: Need E collisions, W timing before contact and Happy Hour availability.
Compare W-hit damage, passive healing and E availability across two exchanges at equal gold.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missing E loses the cooldown reduction; W's short protection can expire while chasing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W's percent-health magic bonus does not multiply separate on-hit item damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Abyssal Mask, Cosmic Drive, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.

builds.name: Fermented barrel displacement
builds.summary: Use a held barrel and R placement to create a larger delayed hit.
builds.goal: Use a held barrel and R placement to create a larger delayed hit.
builds.hypothesis: Barrel Roll's 0.8 AP magic damage rises up to 1.5 times as it ages over four seconds. Explosive Cask's 0.8 AP knockback can displace a target toward the prepared barrel; Rocketbelt adjusts the casting angle, while Horizon reveals qualifying long-range ability hits. This is a placement-dependent damage hypothesis rather than an automatic combo.
testPlan: Required state: Need an aged barrel, a displacement angle and safe range for setup.
Measure aged-Q damage and successful R-into-Q catches against a moving target, logging range for Horizon.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A wrong R angle ejects the enemy away; detonating Q early sacrifices its multiplier.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Every Q detonation is not the full aged damage, and Horizon does not amplify all spells in this source.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
